title: Tiered spillback and compatibility validation harness for regional canary traffic
creator: Lina Chen
description:
Problem: when we deploy model variants across regions and capacity tiers customers sometimes see silent failures or increased latency due to incompatible KV cache layouts, quantization mismatches, or localized capacity exhaustion. Existing rollout tooling focuses on traffic split and basic health metrics but lacks a deterministic preflight and live spillback mechanism that can gracefully route traffic away from stressed capacity tiers without causing global degradation.

Goal: implement a validation harness and routing-level spillback policy ('spillback' = targeted downgrading of routing to lower-risk variants or older pinned models within the same region/tier) that: 1) runs synthetic compatibility probes before increasing live traffic, 2) exposes per-variant safety scores to Console, 3) performs tier-aware spillback to avoid region-wide failovers, and 4) integrates with existing auto-rollback signals for full rollback when necessary.
acceptance_criteria: A preflight job can run compatibility probes (inference correctness, KV-cache warmup, quantized runtime smoke tests) against a candidate model variant in a target region and return a deterministic pass/fail + safety score.
Console shows per-variant safety_score (0-100) and the last probe timestamp; canary UI requires safety_score >= 75 to promote beyond shadow stage.

Live canary that violates latency or quality thresholds will trigger a tiered spillback action that reroutes to a compatible fallback variant within the same capacity tier or to the region's golden variant before performing a cross-region failover.
Spillback actions are rate-limited and logged; operators can eject spillback lanes via Console and get a linked incident runbook and suggested mitigations.
Automated rollback still executes when aggregated failure conditions are met (configurable thresholds) and creates a GitHub PR to pin the previous model version where applicable.
End-to-end e2e tests and a synthetic chaos scenario run in staging that demonstrates spillback prevents full region failover in 3/3 simulated overloads.
design_notes: Safety score composition: weighted metrics = probe_pass_rate (40%), cold-start P95 probe latency delta (30%), inference accuracy/regression signal (20%), resource-stability indicator (10%).

Spillback policy evaluation order: 1) intra-variant degrade (lower maximum concurrency), 2) fall back to variant with compatibility_hint 'pin-compatible', 3) fall back to regional golden variant, 4) schedule cross-region failover as last resort.
We prefer spillback within the same capacity tier to avoid billing surprises; only escalate to higher-cost routes if explicitly allowed by policy or if in enterprise SLA mode.

Compatibility probes will run inside an isolated canary namespace with own KV cache so we can test cache warming and eviction behavior without contaminating prod caches. Probe harness reuses runtime test harness used by infra-qa.
We will surface probe failures and recommended mitigations in Console with links to the failing probe traces and the suggested kernel/quantization parameter toggles.
implementation_plan: Add a 'validation-prober' microservice that can schedule and run the defined probe suite against a candidate variant: unit tests -> integration -> deploy to staging cluster.
Extend provisioning API to accept 'compatibility_hint' and 'safety_profile' metadata per variant; defaults for open models will be inferred but can be overridden by model-onboarding flow.

Routing-layer changes: implement spillback controller that subscribes to probe outputs and runtime telemetry (latency/5xx/quality_regressions) and applies routing mutations via the existing RDS service with gradual rate-limited shifts.
Console: new per-variant card with safety_score, last_probe, probe_log link, and a single-click 'quarantine' toggle that triggers immediate spillback for that variant.
Integrate with rollout orchestration: require probe pass for promotion from shadow -> canary, and require sustained safety_score >= threshold for promotion to >20% traffic.
Add automatic GitHub PR creator for rollback that pins model in the model-catalog repo and opens a PR template with failing metrics and probe logs linked.
Create a gradual rollout feature flag to enable spillback in baby-step customers and internal org first.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal): run probe harness against nightly builds and surface safety_scores in an internal-only Console. Duration: 2 weeks.
Phase 2 (staging chaos): run simulated overloads and compatibility regressions in staging; verify spillback avoids region failover in at least 3 independent runs. Duration: 1 week.
Phase 3 (canary customers): enable feature flag for <10% of tenants with low SLA sensitivity, run shadow probes on any new variant for 48h before allowing canary promotion. Duration: 2 weeks.
Phase 4 (general availability): flip default safety_score requirement for promotions in hosted API; provide admin toggle in Dedicated/Private for operators. Duration: 1 week, monitor 2 weeks.
test_plan: Unit tests for prober logic and safety score calculation with randomized inputs and edge cases.
Integration tests that spin up a miniature runtime with a mock KV cache to validate cache-warmup metrics and cold-start delta calculations.

E2E: staging runbook that includes three simulated faults: quantization mismatch (model returns infrequent NaN tokens), cache-eviction storm, and GPU throttling. Verify routing controller triggers spillback not cross-region failover in each case.
A/B experiment: compare two spillback thresholds (safety_score 60 vs 75) on 50 internal tenants for 7 days and collect latency, cost, and rollout stability metrics.
Smoke test in Private builds to ensure admin toggle and manual quarantine flow works under VPC restrictions.
dependencies: ENG-36210 (RDS rate-limited update API): must land to enable gradual traffic changes
ENG-39188 (Console per-variant cards): UI surface for safety scores
PM-1201 (Model onboarding metadata schema): will define compatibility_hint field
infra/qa pipeline updates: add prober to CI harness
